description: Stop the voting on a WhichDateWorks poll the user organizes, for example once everyone has answered. Pass the poll's manageUrl from create_poll. Returns the leading option so you can tell the user. Picking the final date and notifying everyone happens on the website: the organizer opens manageUrl and signs in.

manageUrl.description: The poll's manageUrl from create_poll (https://app.whichdateworks.com/claim/…), or the token at its end. The invite link won't work here.

name: close_poll

leading.description: The option or options with the most votes, if any.

start.description: Time slot start, in the poll's time zone with its offset.

weekday.description: Day of the week the option falls on, in the poll's time zone, like "Friday". Check it against what the user asked for.

title: Close a poll to votes
